info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Wholesale Trading By Param1-spec
info.description: The Wholesale Trading Management API enables businesses to efficiently manage and update wholesale trading quotes based on specific parameters. By utilizing the PATCH operation, users can modify existing quotes to reflect the most current trading conditions or changes in client agreements. This API serves financial institutions and trading platforms that require quick adjustments to their trading information. With this endpoint, developers can ensure accurate and timely updates to their wholesale trading resources, improving overall transaction management.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of the Quote Management resource identified by RES-100045. You can modify various attributes of the quote based on your business requirements.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the quote management details for the specified wholesale trading operation. Ensure that the fields included adhere to the schema defined for this operation.

200.description: The request was successfully processed and the resource has been updated.
